description: This Java class `DefaultPersistenceStreamConfig` implements the `PersistenceStreamConfig` interface, providing configuration settings for persistence stream operations, including bulk size, parallelism, and exponential backoff configurations.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceStreamConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of PersistenceStreamConfig, holding configuration data for persistence stream settings, such as max bulk size and stream stage configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance of DefaultPersistenceStreamConfig from a provided Config object.

methods.name: getMaxBulkSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum bulk size for persistence operations.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the parallelism level from the default stream stage configuration.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the exponential backoff configuration for retries.
